new_libraries.name: MyDisplayLogging
new_libraries.author: Vic P.
new_libraries.sentence: A Serial-compatible logger for ESP32 that prints to any U8g2 display.
new_libraries.paragraph: Redirect log messages to a display instead of the serial monitor. Features include UTF-8 support (Vietnamese, symbols, emoji), ring buffer for scrollback, log level filtering with [I]/[W]/[E] tags, fixed title bar, and I2C/SPI throttle. Works with any U8g2-supported display out of the box. Pluggable driver architecture makes it easy to add support for other display libraries.
